description: Deterministic fixtures for Language chapter notebooks. All data is constructed or synthetic; no real user data, no model outputs, no credentials.

ward_handover.source: Overnight registrar's notes for a 20-patient ward.
ward_handover.representation: Bed seven: keep an eye on him. Pending blood result pending. Mrs Alvarez, bed three, family needs careful conversation. Mr Chen, bed twelve, stable.
ward_handover.intent: Leave the day team able to recognise the risks and act on them.

reconstructions.receiver: Experienced registrar who covered the ward last week
prior_knowledge: keep an eye on him = check within the hour
reconstructions.recovered: Check bed seven within the hour; watch for observation drift; pending blood result may change everything.
reconstructions.added: Specific one-hour deadline (not in the representation)
reconstructions.missed: Nothing from the representation was lost

reconstructions.receiver: New registrar, first week on the ward
reconstructions.recovered: Bed seven needs vigilance; no particular deadline.
reconstructions.missed: The urgency and conditionality of the original concern

ward_handover.lesson: Representation is not meaning. Identical words produce different reconstructions depending on what the receiver brings.

deadlock.source: Two services deadlock during a Tuesday batch process. Service A holds lock one and waits for lock two; service B holds lock two and waits for lock one.

representations.prose: Service A is holding lock one while waiting for lock two, and service B is holding lock two while waiting for lock one, creating a circular wait.
representations.diagram:
A --> holds lock 1 --> waits for lock 2
B --> holds lock 2 --> waits for lock 1
(circular wait)
representations.demonstration: Two coffee cups as locks, acted out by two people.

deadlock.lesson: Different representations preserve different parts of meaning. The diagram makes the circular relationship visible; prose states it precisely.

incident_report.source: Database failed on Tuesday. Timeline, log excerpts, five candidate causes, a disputed conclusion. Hypothesis three can be excluded only if replication lag is below a specified threshold. The replication-lag measurement is missing.
incident_report.conditional: Hypothesis three excluded only if replication lag below threshold
incident_report.fix: Proposed fix by author J, justification stated
incident_report.faithful_preview: Hypothesis three is excluded only if replication lag is below threshold; that measurement is missing.
preservation_obligations: all five candidate causes and their evidence
who disputes the conclusion and why
hypothesis three is conditional on the lag condition
the proposed fix, its author and justification
where each decision-relevant item appears in the source
incident_report.lesson: A fluent diagram can invert a conditional conclusion by deleting a condition. Survival must be checked against declared obligations, not fluency.

job_queue.request: A job must never be executed twice. A job that fails for a transient reason should be retried up to three times.

readings.reading_a: executed means the worker ran; another attempt breaches the prohibition
readings.reading_b: executed means the queue recorded one completion; retries may charge twice
readings.reading_c: executed means money actually moved; retry permissible only if no second charge

ladder: natural prose: 'A job should never run twice, but transient failures should be retried.'
controlled prose: 'Each job has at most one completed execution. A failed attempt marked transient may be retried up to 3 times.'
structured requirements: R1 recorded completions per job <= 1; R2 additional retries per job, cause = transient, <= 3
schemas and constraints: fields job_id, attempt, status, cause; constraint: count(status=completed, by job_id) <= 1; missing: external-effect identity and deduplication rule
executable contracts: test or runtime assertion that fails when the constraint breaks
state-transition representations: pending -> running -> completed, or running -> failed(transient) -> pending (at most 3 times)
formal specification: invariant stated in logic, with assumptions stated, model shown to satisfy it
job_queue.lesson: A series of mutually consistent representations can all inherit the same initial interpretive mistake. The binding between option, definition and source must be declared.

video_talk.source: One-hour conference talk on a consensus protocol.

moments.content: Speaker defines 'fault' as a node crash, not arbitrary incorrect behaviour. No slide flags the definition.
Speaker demonstrates the protocol committing in two round trips while some nodes crash.
Question about unbounded message delays. Speaker says the fast-commit claim assumes bounded communication delays.

claims: commits in two round trips with crashes

video_talk.misleading_summary: The protocol commits in two round trips.
video_talk.faithful_summary: The protocol commits in two round trips under bounded message delays; faults are node crashes.
video_talk.lesson: A unit must link distant evidence while preserving the route back to each moment. Keeping only minute 42 removes the timing qualification.

subscription_candidates.title: New consensus result possibly weakening bounded-delay assumption
Major update to a library Iris uses often
Survey of consensus protocols, mostly material Iris knows

declared: I want to finish this paper first before opening another
Show implementation detail and equations when they affect the decision
observed: opened tables more often than prose
personal_state.lesson: Declared, observed and inferred are different origins with different authority. A click is not a stable preference.

proxy_scenario.grant: Book one refundable hotel within limits: <= €350/night, specified dates, refundable.
proxy_scenario.counteroffer: €400 per night with a free upgrade.
proxy_scenario.lesson: Preparing words is not transmitting them; transmitting is not performing the speech act. Authority is typed by the act.

language_runtime_trace.scenario: Prepare the Language book for publication: review chapters 10 and 11 first.

stages.description: Interpreter proposes an interpretation bound to source evidence.
Human accepts the interpretation into shared Language State.
Accepted state, public semantics and evidence digests sent to a fresh recipient; original conversation excluded.
Recipient readback proposes an editorial action; simulation shows BLOCKED without a separate grant.

language_runtime_trace.lesson: An intention becomes an agreed semantic state, traceable to source, and another agent can use that state only within its granted authority.
